quote: In an icon only button, that has no label, the icon must accurately represent what the button does.
Icon only buttons should be used sparingly. “For most situations, users learn correct interpretations better with text alone than with icons alone.”

case: Google Android Accessibility — кейс реальных приложений Android
quote: An element like an icon may appear to be 24x24dp but the padding surrounding it comprises the full 48x48dp touch target.

case: Instagram для iOS — реальный кейс, разбор NN/g
quote: For example, on Instagram, the buttons to dismiss a follow suggestion were too small (only 2mm — 0.08in — wide), so even though they are far enough from the Follow buttons (about 2mm of spacing — the often-recommended minimum), they are still hard to select.

Regardless of how recognizable an icon may or may not be, or whether that action lies within the universal actions list, a tooltip is always required with text explaining what the icon button would do if clicked.
Similar to an `` element, an icon alone does not convey any useful information for a screen-reader user.
